name: What if I want a pool and ADU on the same property?

mainEntity.name: Can a luxury pool be planned at the same time as an ADU or major backyard conversion?
mainEntity.text: Can a luxury pool be planned at the same time as an ADU or major backyard conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: A pool and ADU can be planned together, but they should be treated as one site strategy rather than two separate projects. An ADU can change available yard space, utility routing, drainage, access paths, and how the outdoor living area functions. If the pool is designed first and the ADU comes later, the site may become congested or require expensive redesign. Coordinated planning helps preserve circulation, privacy, and a balanced outdoor layout. This is especially important on smaller Los Angeles lots where every square foot matters. Homeowners should ask whether the builder can coordinate the pool with the broader backyard master plan so the final result feels intentional. When the two projects are aligned from the beginning, the property usually works better and the construction process is easier to manage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, but the projects should be coordinated from the start because an ADU can affect access, setbacks, drainage, utilities, and available yard area for the pool. A combined plan usually works better than designing each project separately.
